title: Data-Center Firm Elice Plunges 32% in Debut After Korea IPO
description: Data-center infrastructure company Elice Inc. plunged in its trading debut on South Korea’s tech-heavy Kosdaq market after raising 201 billion won ($151 million) in the bourse’s biggest initial public offering this year.

title: CATL’s Valuation Gap Highlights Investor Divide as Earnings Near
description: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd.’s Hong Kong-listed shares have maintained a considerable premium over their Shenzhen-traded peers after a months-long selloff, underscoring a divide between onshore and offshore investors ahead of the Chinese battery giant’s earnings release.

title: Z.AI Founders Worked on Research Funded by China Institute UK Tied to Spies
description: Four founders of one of China’s most promising artificial intelligence companies, Z.AI Co., worked on research in a joint project with a technology institute that the UK government accused of having “very strong ties” to China’s main spy agency, according to publicly available research papers from China and an “espionage alert” from the UK.
